generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending bidder shall possess a valid class-II and above electrical contract license issued by electrical inspectorate, Government of Karnataka.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The intending bidder shall have executed at least one similar type of work of value not less than Rs. 1.96 Lakhs in LT /HT/Control Panel (above 415V) Erection and commissioning works in any Thermal plants in previous preceding five financial years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. In proof of the same, work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by competent authority shall be uploaded.

The bidder should have minimum annual turnover of Rs.3.92 Lakhs during any two financial year in the last preceding five financial years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26. In proof of the same, Annual Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant shall be submitted.

technicalCriterionList.description: As the subject work is retrofitting in the existing system. Agency shall upload site visit letter as a proof of having understood the scope of work of subject works, system along with site conditions duly obtaining acknowledgement from tender inviting authority.
